name: Camping am Moserhof
beschreibung: The campsite Camping am Moserhof is situated in a tranquil rural setting. It offers peaceful pitches surrounded by picturesque meadows and mountains. The site is equipped with clean sanitary facilities and electrical hookups. Guests can unwind and appreciate the serene countryside. The surrounding area offers numerous trails for hiking and cycling, making the campsite an appealing retreat for a restorative stay.
